name: Editorial serif with a geometric label
description: A tall bold serif (Newsreader) set tight for the headline, with small Jost caps for labels. Literary, warm and confident: a magazine cover or a gallery poster. Pairs with riso and earthy palettes.

name: Condensed grotesk with a mono label
description: Big Shoulders Display bold in capitals, stacked and huge, with Martian Mono labels spaced wide. Industrial, loud, architectural: the swiss poster voice. Pairs with swiss and night palettes.

name: Didone with spaced caps
description: Bodoni Moda bold, high contrast and slightly tight, with widely spaced Jost caps. Fashion, luxury, beauty, perfume, editorial elegance. Pairs with bone, white and night palettes.

name: Condensed sans with a mono label
description: Saira Condensed bold in capitals with Martian Mono labels. Technical, fast and sporty: dashboards, motorsport, tech launches, sport events. Pairs with white-blue and night palettes.

name: Rounded heavy display with a geometric label
description: Lilita One, round and heavy, with Jost labels. Friendly, cheerful and approachable: kids, food, community, casual brands, sales that should smile. Pairs with riso and sunny palettes.

name: Retro display with a bold label
description: Shrikhand, a fat retro display with swing, with bold Jost labels. Nostalgic and fun: diners, vintage markets, record fairs, summer parties. Pairs with riso and forest palettes.
